name: ProxyPose
description: A novel 6-DoF pose tracking system that reframes 3D position and rotation tracking as a video-to-video translation problem. It operates entirely at the pixel level without requiring 3D models or depth sensors.
keyFeatures: Tracks full 3D position and rotation from standard 2D video
Replaces tracked objects with a synthetic proxy polyhedron
Handles transparent, reflective, and highly occluded surfaces effectively
curatorNotes: Partially enriched via migration on 2026-07-25. Manual review recommended.
